why: An ironmongery merchant whose content is good but whose access is shut. robots.txt disallows four answer crawlers and two training crawlers, and also disallows two real content paths; a WAF returns 403 to any AI user agent robots.txt does allow; one product page carries X-Robots-Tag noindex; the about page canonicalises to a different domain; the sitemap advertises a URL that 404s. This is the gate-1 fixture, and it also proves the answer-crawler versus training-crawler split.
note: The training-crawler block must be reported at info severity, never as a defect: opting out of training corpora is a rights decision. The answer-crawler block must be high.
